bosses.note: A white crocolisk.

bosses.name: Shadetooth
bosses.note: A giant violet raptor, leader of the Thicket raptors.

bosses.name: Relic Guardian
bosses.note: Final boss: a stone Titan construct.

quests.name: Open the Maw
quests.pickup: Deathstalker Agent, just outside Excavation Site: Wetlands

dungeons.description: The restored mage city of Dalaran has become a new five-player dungeon in WoW Forever. Enter through the sewers and the Underbelly, then fight through the streets to the Violet Citadel.

bosses.note: At the ritual circle in the Underbelly, surrounded by Kirin Tor Necromancers and rising skeletons. Disarms.

bosses.name: Fel Ancient

dungeons.name: Razorfen Kraul
dungeons.description: A sprawling thorn maze occupied by the quilboar of Razorfen Kraul.

bosses.name: Roogug
bosses.note: A quilboar geomancer near the start of the Kraul.

bosses.name: Charlga Razorflank
bosses.note: Final boss, deep in the Kraul.

bosses.name: Blind Hunter
bosses.note: Rare spawn in the bat caves.

bosses.name: Earthcaller Halmgar
bosses.note: Rare spawn.

quests.name: Blueleaf Tubers
quests.objective: Use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher and the Command Stick to make it find 6 Blueleaf Tubers. Bring them, the Command Stick and the Crate back to Mebok Mizzyrix.

quests.name: Willix the Importer
quests.pickup: Willix the Importer, inside Razorfen Kraul
quests.objective: Escort Willix the Importer out of Razorfen Kraul.
quests.turnin: Willix the Importer, inside Razorfen Kraul

quests.name: Mortality Wanes
quests.objective: Find Treshala's Pendant and return it to Treshala Fallowbrook in Darnassus.

quests.name: The Crone of the Kraul
quests.objective: Bring Razorflank's Medallion to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.

quests.name: A Vengeful Fate
quests.objective: Bring Razorflank's Heart to Auld Stonespire in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Going, Going, Guano!
quests.objective: Bring 1 pile of Kraul Guano from the Kraul bats to Master Apothecary Faranell.

quests.name: An Unholy Alliance
quests.objective: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

dungeons.name: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
dungeons.description: The graveyard wing of the Scarlet Monastery, haunted by restless dead and Scarlet defenders.

bosses.name: Interrogator Vishas
bosses.note: In the Chamber of Atonement. Drops Vorrel's Wedding Ring for Vorrel's Revenge.

bosses.name: Azshir the Sleepless
bosses.note: Rare spawn.

bosses.name: Fallen Champion
bosses.note: Rare spawn.

bosses.name: Ironspine
bosses.note: Rare spawn.

bosses.name: Bloodmage Thalnos
bosses.note: Final boss, in Honor's Tomb.

quests.name: Vorrel's Revenge
quests.objective: Return Vorrel Sengutz's wedding ring (from Nancy Vishas) to Monika Sengutz in Tarren Mill.
quests.turnin: Monika Sengutz, Tarren Mill, Hillsbrad Foothills

quests.name: Hearts of Zeal
quests.objective: Bring 20 Hearts of Zeal from the Scarlet Monastery to Master Apothecary Faranell.

dungeons.name: Scarlet Monastery: Library
dungeons.description: The library wing of the Scarlet Monastery, home to the Houndmaster's kennels and Arcanist Doan's athenaeum.

bosses.name: Houndmaster Loksey
bosses.note: In the Huntsman's Cloister.

bosses.name: Arcanist Doan
bosses.note: Final boss, in the Athenaeum. Doan's Strongbox behind him holds The Scarlet Key.

quests.name: Mythology of the Titans
quests.objective: Retrieve Mythology of the Titans from the Monastery and bring it to Librarian Mae Paledust in Ironforge.

quests.name: Past Due
quests.objective: Retrieve The Lost Magic of the Runemasters from the Scarlet Monastery.
quests.note: New in Forever. The book is held by Arcanist Doan.

quests.name: Compendium of the Fallen
quests.objective: Retrieve the Compendium of the Fallen from the Monastery and return to Sage Truthseeker in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Final Passage
quests.objective: Speak to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: Hearts of Zeal
quests.objective: Bring 20 Hearts of Zeal from the Scarlet Monastery to Master Apothecary Faranell.
